faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 20 vacancies: 1 Dy. General Manager (Projects), 1 Dy. General Manager (Civil), 2 Sr. Manager (Projects), 1 Sr. Manager (Loco), 2 Manager (P. Way), 2 Manager (Projects) and 6 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (ANNEXURE-I) and send it to Chief General Manager (HR), Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Limited, 4th Floor, Nirman Bhavan, Mumbai Port Trust Building, M.P Road, Mazgaon (E), Mumbai - 400010, by post/courier/by hand, to reach by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 63 years (as on 17 November 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 70000-200000 for Dy. General Manager (Projects), 70000-200000 for Dy. General Manager (Civil), 70000-200000 for Sr. Manager (Projects), 70000-200000 for Sr. Manager (Loco), 70000-200000 for Manager (P. Way).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired/VR officers from Railways, Govt Depts, Central PSUs, Ports, JV Companies. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening. Interview. Screening / interaction.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Annual contract extendable based on performance and company requirement.

faq.question: Q9. Which places are covered by IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Phusro, Farakka, Korba, Kolkata, Paradip, Ghargheda, Vijayawada, Chennai.

faq.answer: Matriculation Certificate; Educational/Professional certificates; Experience certificates; PPO and last drawn Salary Slip; Updated CV; Photo ID and address proof.
